t2 <- tab_glm(61714, 60585)
reg <- glm(data = t2, 
           proportion_interet ~ year)
summary(reg)
## 
## Call:
## glm(formula = proportion_interet ~ year, data = t2)
## 
## Coefficients:
##              Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)  
## (Intercept) -4.345581   2.539663  -1.711   0.0871 .
## year         0.002329   0.001259   1.850   0.0644 .
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## (Dispersion parameter for gaussian family taken to be 0.129708)
## 
##     Null deviance: 504.88  on 3890  degrees of freedom
## Residual deviance: 504.43  on 3889  degrees of freedom
## AIC: 3098.9
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 2
t3 <- t2 %>%
  filter(!(proportion_interet %in% c(0, 1)))
reg <- glm(data = t3, 
           proportion_interet ~ year)
summary(reg)

## Call:
